title.narrative: Deep Surface - Exhibition on polyfunctional architecture to enhance the experience of UNESCO designated sites

description.narrative: This project aims to enhance UNESCO designated sites (with a special focus on World Heritage properties, Biosphere Reserves, and UNESCO Global Geoparks) as laboratories for sustainable development by promoting quality architectural solutions that improve the protection, accessibility, interpretation and appreciation of cultural and natural heritage. This will be achieved through the organization of: - A global exhibition on polyfunctional architecture to enhance the experience of UNESCO designated sites. The activity will showcase the shared mission and context-specific architectural and functional features of selected visitor centres in UNESCO designated sites, and notably their experiences and good practices concerning: heritage protection; education and heritage interpretation; inclusivity and community-oriented services; enhancement of cognitive and physical accessibility of sites; sustainable tourism management; and the innovative application of digital technologies. The exhibition will be hosted within the premises of the UNESCO Regional Bureau for Science and Culture in Europe, in Venice (Italy), from May to November 2025, on the occasion of the 19th International Architecture Exhibition of La Biennale di Venezia. - An international symposium convening leading thinkers and practitioners for global dialogue and exchange on the exhibition’s subject (possibly on the occasion of the inauguration)
